records.description: Introducing M2.5, an open-source frontier model designed for real-world productivity. SOTA performance at coding (SWE-Bench Verified 80.2%), search (BrowseComp 76.3%), agentic tool-calling (BFCL 76.8%) & office work. Optimized for efficient execution, 37% faster at complex tasks. At $1 per hour with 100 tps, infinite scaling of long-horizon agents now economically possible.

records.name: Voice-Native App Directory
records.tagline: Discover and submit apps built for voice first
records.description: Voice-Native App Directory is the curated directory for voice-native applications - apps that treat voice as the primary interface, not an afterthought. Every app is reviewed before listing to ensure genuine voice-native interaction. Filter by category, platform, or pricing. Upvote your favorites. Built for developers, founders, and voice-tech enthusiasts who want to discover what's possible when voice comes first. Developers: submit your voice-native app for free and get listed in the directory

records.name: Cute Magick
records.tagline: Self-host websites with infinite undo
records.description: Cute Magick is a self-hostable, Git-backed website environment with built-in infinite undo. It's for people who want to build real websites, but don't want to fight platforms, config, and SaaS billing just to experiment, learn, or keep infinite projects alive. You get a real server, real files, real URLs, and the ability to rewind your site's entire history at any time.

records.name: NFT Marketplace Clone Script
records.tagline: Feature-Rich NFT Marketplace Clone Software
records.description: NFT Marketplace Clone Script is a ready-to-deploy, blockchain-powered solution to launch a secure and scalable NFT trading platform. It supports multi-chain integration, smart contracts, wallet connectivity, royalty management, auctions, and advanced admin controls. Fully customizable with high-performance architecture, it enables startups and enterprises to build feature-rich NFT marketplaces with faster deployment and reduced development costs.

records.name: GroanDeck
records.tagline: A free dad joke API with 2k+ jokes, search, and a WP plugin
records.description: GroanDeck is a free, open API serving 2,000+ curated dad jokes. Get a random joke, search by keyword, or filter by category — all with a single REST call. Ships with a WordPress plugin (Gutenberg block + shortcode) and full documentation. The site itself has daily challenges, reaction tracking, and community submissions. No API key required.

records.name: NeuralGPT
records.tagline: Xhnaa
records.description: Anyyyy

records.name: Nairel
records.tagline: A marketplace for what comes next-AI-powered selling & more
records.description: Nairel is a full marketplace where you can buy and sell anything What makes it different: → AI Seller Brain writes your listings, suggests prices, forecasts demand → Live commerce — go live, show products, run auctions, drop exclusive deals → Buyer protection on every purchase as standard → Zero listing fees, zero monthly fees → Social copy generator for Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, Facebook → Works for every category, not just clothes 400+ products live. AI tools included for every seller.

records.name: Fluxin.ai
records.tagline: Marketing support tool for SMBs, create, schedule & run ads
records.description: Automate your marketing with Fluxin.ai. Generate content, schedule posts, launch ad campaigns, and get insights. Most tools help you make a post. Fluxin helps you run the whole thing: brand → content → scheduling → ads → performance. Our mission is “big-brand” marketing quality for small businesses, without the big-brand price tag. Soft-launched and live now: start the 7-day free trial + 400 coins, then use code PH7D at signup to unlock +7 extra days + 500 coins. Total: 14 days + 900 coins.

records.name: LN Webworks
records.tagline: Human-First Digital Solutions | LN Webworks
records.description: Fast, secure, and built to scale. LN Webworks engineers high performance websites for SaaS, e-commerce, and global digital brands. From custom designs to robust CMS and responsive platforms, we focus on user-friendly, reliable web experiences that help startups and enterprises grow online.

records.name: Auden
records.tagline: Your day-to-day AI memory that listens and remembers
records.description: Auden is OS-level tool available on Desktop, Tablet and Mobile that let you record and listen to any type of audio you want to remember later. is listens, summarizes what has been said and saves the recording playback and categorizes it, all powered with AI!

records.name: So Many Errands
records.tagline: Make $35 - $55/hr by Running Errands OR Hire Errand Runners
records.description: Hire Errand Runners OR Earn $35+/hr running errands like cleaning, furniture assembly, moving, yard work, handyman chores, and more! Or hire trusted local errand runners to get things done fast. Instant payments, no hidden fees.

records.name: SilentZone
records.tagline: Respect Every Moment. Automatically.
records.description: Silent Zone automatically silences your phone when you arrive at places that matter — mosques, offices, schools, or anywhere you set. No more embarrassing ringtones during prayer or meetings. Simply add a location, set your schedule, and forget about it. Silent Zone handles the rest, restoring your sound the moment you leave. Smart geofencing + time-based scheduling that works even overnight. Your phone, finally well-mannered.

records.name: Repimly
records.tagline: Open source image editing. Simple as that.
records.description: Repimly is a cutting-edge image editor that leverages the power of AI to provide a seamless and efficient editing experience.

records.name: DeckGuard
records.tagline: Find the risks in your pitch deck before investors do.
records.description: Upload your pitch deck, select your funding stage (Pre-Seed to Series A), and get an instant risk analysis based on Y Combinator standards. DeckGuard checks market logic, business model clarity, unit economics, and stage alignment — then gives you likely investor questions and defense prompts. No sugarcoating.

records.name: ColorAdapt Gaming
records.tagline: HDR & Path‑Tracing vibes, system‑wide. RTX‑style visuals!
records.description: A lightweight, system‑wide HDR/Path‑Tracing‑like color filter for desktop and games. Works on all GPUs, anti‑cheat friendly, zero latency, and includes accessibility presets (Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia). Quick hotkeys, no telemetry — just cinematic clarity and visual comfort everywhere. P.S. To all investors and companies: This soft is worth millions — don’t miss your chance! Write to me with your proposals before someone else grabs the opportunity.

records.name: GridTake
records.tagline: The first real-time debate & verdict platform for F1 fans
records.description: GridTake is the first real-time platform for F1 fans who value technical analysis over noise. Whether it's a controversial overtake or a budget cap breach, you become the steward. Key Features: Live Incident Feed: Join debates as they happen. The Verdict Engine: Vote and compare fan consensus with official FIA rulings. Steward Reputation: Earn credibility for data-backed takes. No more noise, just racing.

records.name: Bondhuu
records.tagline: A retro social network for the modern age.
records.description: Remember when the internet felt like a playground? Bondhuu is a retro-inspired social space built for nostalgia. We’ve stripped away the toxic algorithms and "for you" pages to bring back profiles, personal expression, and genuine digital friendship.

records.name: GyanTutor
records.tagline: AI Tutor for CBSE Students
records.description: GyanTutor is an AI‑powered learning platform designed specifically for CBSE students from Classes 8 to 12. It helps students solve doubts instantly, understand concepts step‑by‑step, generate quizzes, and revise using voice tutor support. Built to provide personalized and affordable academic assistance, GyanTutor enables students to learn anytime, reduce exam stress, and improve confidence. The platform aims to make quality education accessible through smart AI‑driven learning tools for students

records.name: Lumina
records.tagline: Nuke YouTube distractions. Master focus with smart notes.
records.description: YouTube is the world's best university, but it's also the world's loudest library. Lumina helps you reclaim your attention. 🏮 The Zen UI: Instantly hide sidebars, comments, and recommendation traps. 📝 Smart Notepad: Take timestamped notes right over the video player. 🛡️ Privacy First: No login, no servers. Your notes stay 100% local on your machine. Stop scrolling and start mastering. Shed light on what matters with Lumina.

records.name: PRtidy
records.tagline: AI-powered PR summaries & code reviews to ship code faster
records.description: PRtidy is an AI reviewer for GitHub pull requests. It analyzes every PR to generate clear summaries, detect bugs, flag security risks, and highlight maintainability issues before merge. By handling repetitive checks automatically, PRtidy shortens review cycles and keeps code quality consistent — so developers spend less time reading diffs and more time shipping features with confidence.

records.name: Rinee Bindra
records.tagline: Beauty parlour in jalandhar
records.description: If you want to get radiant and lovely skin, turn your head towards Beauty Parlour Jalandhar. Rinee Bindra, a top beauty and makeup artist in Jalandhar

records.name: Workvia Studio Landing Pages from €85/mo
records.tagline: Get your website at €85 a month
records.description: Workvia Studio offers affordable landing page design for small businesses starting at €85/month. Get online quickly with a premium small business website crafted in Cyprus.

records.name: Anexabase
records.tagline: App Store screenshots & ASO editor for Apple developers
records.description: Anexabase turns painful App Store asset management into a streamlined workflow. Design screenshots in a Figma-like editor with device mockups and templates, manage titles, subtitles, keywords, descriptions, and localizations in one ASO workspace, then sync screenshots and metadata straight to App Store Connect via the API. No more spreadsheets, copy-paste, or jumping between tools.

records.name: DhanikaCal
records.tagline: Smart financial & practical calculators built for India
records.description: DhanikaCal is a fast, clean collection of 460+ practical calculators built specifically for Indian users. From SIP, EMI, income tax, GST, and salary calculators to engineering and utility tools — everything is optimized for Indian currency formatting (lakhs & crores). Unlike generic global calculator sites, DhanikaCal focuses on India-first financial decisions and real-life use cases. No clutter, no login, just instant results.

records.name: Dear Past Me
records.tagline: Meet your past self without opening your journal.
records.description: Dear Past Me is a minimalist journal designed for reunion, not logging. Most journal apps optimize for writing. Dear Past Me optimizes for rediscovery. Your past entries surface automatically — even through iOS widgets — so you can encounter your previous thoughts without searching or scrolling.

records.name: Salonfy
records.tagline: All-in-one software for salons, spas & beauty clinics
records.description: All-in-one AI-powered salon management platform for beauty, hair, nail and spa businesses. Build your own branded website in 3 clicks. Go beyond booking with automated marketing that reactivates inactive clients, AI revenue forecasting, sentiment analysis, loyalty programs, targeted offers and discounts. Manage clients, staff, payments and growth in one place.

records.name: Justice Index
records.tagline: 1.3 million federal cases anlyzed. Racial disparities proven
records.description: 23 years of federal sentencing data expose persistent racial disparities in the US criminal justice system. 1.3 million cases. The numbers speak for themselves.

records.name: Man AI
records.tagline: The marketplace built for AI agents
records.description: AI Agent Marketplace - Buy and sell AI agent services, data, and compute resources

records.name: Typrio
records.tagline: Private AI for your iPhone. Runs locally. No tracking.
records.description: Typrio runs AI locally on your iPhone for maximum privacy, with optional cloud support via OpenRouter, Venice.ai, Anthropic, OpenAI and more.

records.name: LastPosty
records.tagline: AI-crafted social posts in moments
records.description: AI-Powered Social Media Automation - Auto-fetch, generate, and publish content.

records.name: Drivebase
records.tagline: Unified file manager for all your cloud storage with E2EE
records.description: Drivebase is an open-source, cloud-agnostic file manager that lets you organize, upload, share, and collaborate on files across multiple providers from one interface. With Vault, its end-to-end encryption feature, your files are encrypted before they leave your device so only you can access them. Connect Google Drive, S3, Dropbox, or OneDrive, manage a unified folder structure, choose storage per file, and stay fully in control with a self-hosted, privacy-first setup free from vendor lock-in.

records.name: Chicken Tinder
records.tagline: Swipe. Match. Add to cart. Dinner solved.
records.description: ChickenTinder helps households finally agree on meals — whether you’re cooking at home or heading out. Swipe through recipes together. If everyone’s in, it’s locked. Prefer takeout? Swipe local restaurants and match on where to go. When you choose a recipe, one tap sends every ingredient straight to your grocery cart for pickup or delivery. No group chat chaos. No forgotten ingredients. No decision fatigue. Just swipe. Match. Eat.

records.name: Blue Squircle
records.tagline: AI delivery intelligence for project-driven businesses
records.description: AI-powered delivery intelligence platform for project management. Predictive analytics, risk identification, and intelligent task assignment for SaaS startups, consultancies, agencies, and education institutions. From 9 GBP per seat.

records.name: GitStatus
records.tagline: Turn your GitHub repos into leaderboards and tournaments.
records.description: Hey Product Hunt! We built GitStatus at Brigada to run coding tournaments—pick repos, set a deadline, and compete on commits and streaks for a prize. GitHub doesn’t offer that, so we built it. Scoring is simple: points = commits + (longest streak × 5). Share an 8-char code and your team’s in. Plus leaderboards, heatmaps, streak badges, and gap analysis for any repo or branch. Free, 30-second setup. We read commit metadata, never code. Would you run one?

records.name: aetherCam
records.tagline: Video, driven by sound
records.description: Built for content creators and musicians, AetherCam lets you shape your sound on the fly. Whether you’re filming an acoustic performance, a vocal take, or a quick social post, your audio becomes part of the performance itself. AetherCam turns your iPhone’s microphone into a live audio workstation. Open the FX Rack and apply studio-quality effects in real time: add reverb to give your guitar space, dial in delay for depth, sculpt your tone with a 3-band EQ, or tighten things up with a compressor

records.name: Vela
records.tagline: AI scheduling that works the way a great EA does
records.description: Vela is an AI scheduling agent that works the way a great EA does - across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and phone, at any scale. Loop Vela into a conversation and it takes over. It negotiates times, follows up when people ghost, and books the meeting. It has taste: it prioritizes an investor over an internal sync, and understands "early next week" without rigid parameters. Need 1,000 interviews scheduled this week? Vela makes parallel calls and coordinates across every channel. Backed by YC W26!
